session-preview.label.meaning: A node showing a selected saved state or camera from another session in the same project, excluding node notes from the rendered image while retaining actual text content.
session-preview.label.scope: UI interface session-preview insertion and image-node properties.
session-preview.label.referent: A node showing a selected saved state or camera from another session in the same project.
session-preview.label.precedence: Source content belongs to its session; target layout and retained immutable images belong to the UI session. This is distinct from a spatial-only camera reference.
examples: Place the named state of another UI session in a UI layout.
nonExamples: Upload an unrelated image or embed the editor viewport.
